title: LeadIntelligenceContracts
description: Generated from services/research-engine/src/research_engine/contracts.py and domain.py (protocol version 1, data contract version 1). Do not edit by hand.

AcquiredPage.description: One fetch: request URL, outcome and where its body is stored (relative to the data dir).
AcquiredPage.title: AcquiredPage

AiBenchmarkResult.description: One model on one task over the synthetic labelled corpus, measured on this machine.
AiBenchmarkResult.title: AiBenchmarkResult

AiDevice.description: Where the runtime placed the model while it answered, as the runtime reported it.
AiDevice.title: AiDevice

AiDraftedReason.description:
A local model's wording of a problem, kept only when every finding it cites is evidence of
this scorecard. It never changes a number.
AiDraftedReason.title: AiDraftedReason

AiInferenceDetail.description:
A model's answer as evidence-backed output: the run, every raw answer next to what it
validated to, the exact inputs it cited and the people's decisions. Not a fact.
AiInferenceDetail.title: AiInferenceDetail

AiInputRef.description:
One piece of evidence a model saw, as it saw it: the page, finding or subscore it came from
and the exact text (a screenshot keeps only its path and hash).
AiInputRef.title: AiInputRef

AiModelChangeRequest.description:
Downloads or deletes a model through the runtime. `confirmation` must repeat the model name:
nothing is downloaded or deleted without that explicit step.
AiModelChangeRequest.title: AiModelChangeRequest

AiOutcome.description: `insufficient_evidence`: the input does not support an answer; the output says nothing.
AiOutcome.title: AiOutcome

AiProfile.description: A model assignment the operator configures; each task runs on one profile.
AiProfile.title: AiProfile

AiProfileSetting.description: The model a profile runs on and its context length; no model means the profile is off.
AiProfileSetting.title: AiProfileSetting

AiRecommendation.description:
A recommendation, never a setting: the best benchmarked model on this machine for a task
(accuracy first, then median latency), among models still installed.
AiRecommendation.title: AiRecommendation

AiResourceLimits.description: Free memory below which crawling and browser renders wait while local AI works.
AiResourceLimits.title: AiResourceLimits

AiStartRequest.description:
Runs tasks over the canonical businesses of one project (every project when null), or over
the businesses listed (at most 200). Identical requests reuse valid stored results.
AiStartRequest.title: AiStartRequest

AiTaskType.description:
What a local model may be asked (phase 10). Each task has its own contract, prompt template,
limits, timeout and failure strategy (`ai.tasks`); none of them decides a fact on its own.
AiTaskType.title: AiTaskType

AiVramEstimate.description:
An estimate from the model's own metadata (weights file, layers, KV heads) for one context
length; the runtime's report of a loaded model (`size_vram_bytes`) is what actually happened.
AiVramEstimate.title: AiVramEstimate

Area.description: A place an ICP includes or excludes. A part left empty matches any value.
Area.title: Area

AttemptResult.description: What one attempt to work a lead produced, as the analyst recorded it. Nothing is sent.
AttemptResult.title: AttemptResult

AuditEntry.description: Append-only trail of important changes (status, soft delete, restore, purge, merge).
AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry

BriefClaim.description:
One statement of a brief, restating stored data. `ref` (B1, B2...) is what a model cites;
`is_inference` marks a probable consequence, never a fact.
BriefClaim.title: BriefClaim

BriefDraft.description:
The newest valid, not rejected `sales_brief` answer, reduced to sentences whose every cited
claim is still in the brief; the others are dropped and counted.
BriefDraft.title: BriefDraft

BriefRef.description: A stored row a brief, a pin or a timeline entry points at.
BriefRef.title: BriefRef

BrowserMode.description: When a page may be rendered in Chromium: never, on a verifiable criterion, or always.
BrowserMode.title: BrowserMode

BulkAction.description: Safe actions over many leads. `sales_ready` needs its criteria per lead: never in bulk.
BulkAction.title: BulkAction

BulkRequest.description:
One action over leads chosen by id (at most 1 000), or over every lead a query matches (at
most 5 000, applied only while that is still the count the analyst previewed).
BulkRequest.title: BulkRequest

Business.description: Canonical business. Display values are chosen from observations, which keep raw values.
Business.title: Business

BusinessClassification.description: A category or a service as the source labelled it, optionally mapped to a taxonomy.
BusinessClassification.title: BusinessClassification

BusinessDetail.description:
A business with every observation of every record resolved into it (phase 06), the value
chosen for each field and the merge history. A record that is itself merged shows only its own
observations; `business.merged_into_id` says where it belongs.
BusinessDetail.title: BusinessDetail

BusinessFacts.description:
Everything a score read about one canonical business, stored with the score, so the same
facts can be scored again with other versions (`facts_from_run_id`).
BusinessFacts.title: BusinessFacts

BusinessMerge.description:
One record joining a cluster: why (a snapshot of the pair's explanation), by whom, and when
it was undone. History: only the unmerge fields are ever written after the insert.
BusinessMerge.title: BusinessMerge

BusinessPage.description: One keyset page. `total` counts every match of the filters, not only this page.
BusinessPage.title: BusinessPage

BusinessScore.description: Immutable, permanent result for one business in one run: the facts read and the scorecard.
BusinessScore.title: BusinessScore

CalibrationReport.description:
Offline metrics of one run against the outcomes recorded after its facts were read. Nothing
is trained; with few labels every number is a warning, not a verdict.
CalibrationReport.title: CalibrationReport

Campaign.description: What to look for; `criteria_json` follows the discovery criteria schema version.
Campaign.title: Campaign

CampaignListItem.description: A campaign with its criteria and what its runs have produced so far.
CampaignListItem.title: CampaignListItem

CampaignSaveRequest.description: Creates a campaign when `campaign_id` is null, otherwise replaces its editable fields.
CampaignSaveRequest.title: CampaignSaveRequest

CampaignSaved.description: The stored campaign plus what validation says about it; problems never block a draft.
CampaignSaved.title: CampaignSaved

CandidateDetail.description: The candidate with the whole chain behind it, down to the payload as it was received.
CandidateDetail.title: CandidateDetail

CandidateListItem.description: A candidate reference. It is not a lead and carries no score: phase 04 only finds it.
CandidateListItem.title: CandidateListItem

CandidateListQuery.description: Candidates never cross campaigns: a listing is scoped by campaign or by run.
CandidateListQuery.title: CandidateListQuery

CanonicalChoiceRequest.description: Makes one observation the value a business shows for a field.
CanonicalChoiceRequest.title: CanonicalChoiceRequest

CanonicalValue.description:
Which observation represents a cluster for one field, chosen by policy or by a person.

`alternative_count` is how many different values the cluster holds for that field: above one,
the business has a conflict the interface must show. Superseded, never overwritten.
CanonicalValue.title: CanonicalValue

Capability.description: What a source can actually do. The builder shows these; the engine enforces them.
Capability.title: Capability

CapacityCriterion.description:
Buying capacity through explicit proxies only (locations, paid tools, a published team, site
depth), never a financial claim.
CapacityCriterion.title: CapacityCriterion

CategoryCriterion.description: Terms matched as whole words against the category and service labels sources observed.
CategoryCriterion.title: CategoryCriterion

ChannelCriterion.description:
At least one usable published channel of these types, and a published decision maker when
asked for.
ChannelCriterion.title: ChannelCriterion

ChecklistDefinition.description:
A checklist applies to the businesses of its campaigns first, then of its categories (whole
words); with neither it applies to every lead no other checklist claims.
ChecklistDefinition.title: ChecklistDefinition

ChecklistRule.description: What an automatic checklist item reads from the stored facts.
ChecklistRule.title: ChecklistRule

ChildJob.description: An engine job a stage started, or attached because it was already open for the project.
ChildJob.title: ChildJob

ClusterMember.description: A record resolved into a business, with the source it came from.
ClusterMember.title: ClusterMember

ColumnMapping.description: Which column of an imported file feeds which candidate field. Unmapped fields stay empty.
ColumnMapping.title: ColumnMapping

CommandError.description: Error shape every Tauri command rejects with.
CommandError.title: CommandError

ConfigField.description: One setting a source needs. Secrets live in the connector configuration, not in criteria.
ConfigField.title: ConfigField

ContactAction.title: ContactAction

ContactActionRequest.description:
An action on one channel of a business. Every action but `validate` and `mark_primary` needs
a reason; `check_mail_domains` lets `validate` ask DNS for an uncached mail domain.
ContactActionRequest.title: ContactActionRequest

ContactChannel.description:
A contact channel of a canonical business: every observation of the same value,
consolidated. `validation_status` is the exact status its observations carry (see
docs/contact-intelligence.md).
ContactChannel.title: ContactChannel

ContactConflict.description:
Values that disagree (`values_disagree`), or a value other businesses publish too
(`shared_value`). Shown, never resolved silently.
ContactConflict.title: ContactConflict

ContactDetail.description:
The contacts of a canonical business: channels (published or imported), hypotheses kept
apart, published people, conflicts, the contactability subscore and the review history.
ContactDetail.title: ContactDetail

ContactLevel.description: Whom a channel reaches: the business, one of its locations, or a published person.
ContactLevel.title: ContactLevel

ContactListQuery.description:
Channels of the canonical businesses of a project (or of every project). Hypotheses and
suppressed channels are left out unless asked for.
ContactListQuery.title: ContactListQuery

ContactPoint.description: Phone, email, form or social profile of a business, location or published person.
ContactPoint.title: ContactPoint

ContactQuality.description: Whom the contact route actually reached.
ContactQuality.title: ContactQuality

ContactRole.title: ContactRole

ContactSignal.description:
One fact a validation read: `line_type`, `role_address`, `disposable`, `mail_domain`,
`catch_all` (always `not_checked`), `form_fields`... with its value when it has one.
ContactSignal.title: ContactSignal

ContactSource.description:
One observation of a channel: the record business it belongs to and where it came from.
`current` is false when a newer crawl of the same page no longer shows it.
ContactSource.title: ContactSource

ContactStartRequest.description:
Checks the contacts of one project, or of every live project when `project_id` is null (one
job each). `check_mail_domains` allows DNS lookups of mail domains missing from the cache; off,
or with the worker offline, the run never touches the network.
ContactStartRequest.title: ContactStartRequest

ContactStats.description: Counts of one contact run, read back from its last checkpoint.
ContactStats.title: ContactStats

ContactSuppression.description:
One entry of the local do-not-contact list (phase 09). `value` is the normalised address,
E.164 number, registrable domain or business id. Lifting keeps the entry as history.
ContactSuppression.title: ContactSuppression

Contactability.description:
An explainable subscore of how reachable a business is through the channels it publishes or
the operator imported. Not the lead score; `score` is null when a gate stops it.
Contactability.title: Contactability

CorrectionView.description:
A value an analyst corrected: a manual observation with its reason, never an edited
source.
CorrectionView.title: CorrectionView

CrawlErrorGroup.description: Pages that failed for the same reason. robots.txt and sitemaps report through their site.
CrawlErrorGroup.title: CrawlErrorGroup

CrawlMetrics.description: Measured from the fetch log, never estimated. Latencies cover fetches a server answered.
CrawlMetrics.title: CrawlMetrics

CrawlRun.description: One crawl job. `in_flight`: URLs being fetched right now, when this worker runs the job.
CrawlRun.title: CrawlRun

CrawlSettings.description: Budget and policy of one crawl. The bounds are the safe limits in docs/crawling.md.
CrawlSettings.title: CrawlSettings

CrawlSite.description: One site of a crawl: its own source run, budget spent and outcome.
CrawlSite.title: CrawlSite

CrawlStartRequest.description: Crawls the websites of a campaign's candidates, the URLs given, or both.
CrawlStartRequest.title: CrawlStartRequest

CrawlUrl.description:
One URL of a site crawl: frontier entry while queued, fetch log once final (phase 05).

The body is an `acquired_page` artifact and the parsed page a `raw_record`; this row says how
they were obtained (method, timings, redirects, allowed headers) or why the URL was not fetched
(`reason`). `content_sha256` hashes the normalised visible text, so identical pages under
different URLs point at the first one through `duplicate_of_id`.
CrawlUrl.title: CrawlUrl

CrawlUrlDetail.description: A URL with how it was obtained, the stored bytes and the parsed page, down to the hashes.
CrawlUrlDetail.title: CrawlUrlDetail

CrawlUrlListQuery.description: URLs of one crawl, in the order they were discovered.
CrawlUrlListQuery.title: CrawlUrlListQuery

CrawlUrlStatus.description: Where one URL of a site crawl stands. Everything but `queued` is final.
CrawlUrlStatus.title: CrawlUrlStatus

CriteriaCheck.description: Validation of one criteria document. `estimates` are marked estimates, never counts.
CriteriaCheck.title: CriteriaCheck

CriteriaProblem.description: One reason a campaign cannot run (error) or deserves a second look (warning).
CriteriaProblem.title: CriteriaProblem

CriterionImportance.description: must_have: a gate before any weight; nice_to_have: counts in ICP_MATCH; ignore: not read.
CriterionImportance.title: CriterionImportance

DatasetCleanupRequest.description:
Deletes old snapshot versions of a dataset, keeping the newest `keep_latest` and whatever
lineage or exports still need. Preview first; applying needs a reason.
DatasetCleanupRequest.title: DatasetCleanupRequest

DatasetQuality.description: Computed from the snapshot's Parquet copy when it is written; never estimated.
DatasetQuality.title: DatasetQuality

DatasetSnapshot.description: Immutable, reproducible rows in DuckDB plus a partitioned Parquet copy.
DatasetSnapshot.title: DatasetSnapshot

DatasetSnapshotRequest.description:
Captures a project as the next version of a dataset: a consistent read at one moment. The
rows carry the tiers and scores of `score_run_id`, or of the newest finished run when null.
DatasetSnapshotRequest.title: DatasetSnapshotRequest

DatasetSnapshotSource.description: Lineage of a snapshot: exactly one of a source run, a score run or a parent snapshot.
DatasetSnapshotSource.title: DatasetSnapshotSource

DecisionMaker.description: A person only when published by a legitimate business source, with context.
DecisionMaker.title: DecisionMaker

DecisionMakerListQuery.description: Published people of a project, by review status (the review queue asks for `ambiguous`).
DecisionMakerListQuery.title: DecisionMakerListQuery

DecisionMakerRelationship.description: The relationship a published role states; `unknown` when the role says none of these.
DecisionMakerRelationship.title: DecisionMakerRelationship

DecisionMakerReview.description:
unreviewed: extracted with nothing that makes it doubtful; ambiguous: waits in the review
queue (its reasons say why); confirmed or rejected: a person decided.
DecisionMakerReview.title: DecisionMakerReview

DiscoveryCandidate.description:
A discovered reference, not a business: the light projection of one raw record (phase 04).

`dedup_key` is the connector's cheap identity guess; a row repeating a key already seen in the
same campaign points at the first one through `duplicate_of_id`. Nothing is merged here - entity
resolution is phase 06.
DiscoveryCandidate.title: DiscoveryCandidate

DiscoveryCriteria.description: What a campaign looks for, stored verbatim in `campaigns.criteria_json`.
DiscoveryCriteria.title: DiscoveryCriteria

DiscoveryLimits.description: Hard ceilings for one run. The engine stops at the first one reached and says which.
DiscoveryLimits.title: DiscoveryLimits

DiscoveryRun.description: One discovery job: its sources, its totals and the last things it said.
DiscoveryRun.title: DiscoveryRun

DiscoverySourceRun.description: What one source did inside a run. `cursor` is where a resume would continue.
DiscoverySourceRun.title: DiscoverySourceRun

DiscoveryStartRequest.description:
Starts one discovery job for a campaign.

`inputs` carry what a run needs but a campaign cannot hold: the text of an imported file, a
list of manual seeds. They are keyed by connector and stored with the run.
DiscoveryStartRequest.title: DiscoveryStartRequest

DiscoveryStrategy.description: Broad first (cast wide, filter later) or narrow (only the tightest matches).
DiscoveryStrategy.title: DiscoveryStrategy

EmptyPayload.description: Payload of requests that take no parameters (health, diagnostics, shutdown).
EmptyPayload.title: EmptyPayload

EntityRecord.description: The record business a candidate became (phase 06). One per candidate, for ever.
EntityRecord.title: EntityRecord

Envelope.description: One JSON Lines frame. `payload` and `error` are mutually exclusive.
Envelope.title: Envelope

EventCleanupRequest.description: Deletes old events of finished jobs. Errors are never deleted: they are the root causes.
EventCleanupRequest.title: EventCleanupRequest

EvidenceDetail.description: One stored row behind a claim, looked up only within the business it belongs to.
EvidenceDetail.title: EvidenceDetail

EvidenceItem.description: An observed claim: value, snippet and hash, strength, confidence. Only `status` changes.
EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem

EvidencePin.description:
Evidence an analyst marked as important for a lead. Unpinning keeps the row, with a
reason.
EvidencePin.title: EvidencePin

EvidenceRefKind.description:
The stored rows a brief, a pin or a timeline entry can point at. `contact_channel` refs are
channel keys (phase 09 consolidates contact points into channels); every other ref is an id.
EvidenceRefKind.title: EvidenceRefKind

Exclusions.description: Filtered out before a candidate is stored, so an excluded name never reaches the list.
Exclusions.title: Exclusions

ExplorerCondition.description:
One test on one field. Unary operators take no value; `in` and `not_in` take a list; number
fields compare with a number; enum and set fields accept only their own values.
ExplorerCondition.title: ExplorerCondition

ExplorerField.description:
What the explorer filters, sorts and shows. Live fields read the current state (stage,
research, tags, suppression, age of the facts); the others are the run's snapshot.
ExplorerField.title: ExplorerField

ExplorerGroup.description:
Conditions and groups joined by `and` or `or`, optionally negated. At most
`EXPLORER_MAX_DEPTH` levels and `EXPLORER_MAX_CONDITIONS` conditions in the whole tree.
ExplorerGroup.title: ExplorerGroup

ExplorerQuery.description:
One window of the explorer over a score run (the newest finished one when null): filters, a
quick search, up to four sort keys (the run's rank order when none) and an offset.
ExplorerQuery.title: ExplorerQuery

ExplorerSort.description: A sort key. Missing values always come last; the business id breaks the remaining ties.
ExplorerSort.title: ExplorerSort

ExportDefinition.description: What a preset fixes: the source kind, the format, the columns and their headers.
ExportDefinition.title: ExportDefinition

ExportDestination.description:
What the desktop core's save dialog returned: a one-time grant the interface passes back to
start the export, and the file name and folder to show. The path never reaches the page.
ExportDestination.title: ExportDestination

ExportDraft.description:
Everything an export needs but its destination, which the desktop core adds from the save
dialog: the interface never names a path.
ExportDraft.title: ExportDraft

ExportPreset.description: One immutable version of an export preset (built in, or cloned and saved by a person).
ExportPreset.title: ExportPreset

ExportPresetSaveRequest.description:
A new preset (cloned from `clone_from`, or from nothing) or the next version of a saved one.
Built-in presets are cloned, never changed.
ExportPresetSaveRequest.title: ExportPresetSaveRequest

ExportPreviewRequest.description: What an export of the explorer's query would hold. Nothing is written (exports: phase 13).
ExportPreviewRequest.title: ExportPreviewRequest

ExportPreviewResult.description: The first rows exactly as the file would hold them, with the counts and warnings.
ExportPreviewResult.title: ExportPreviewResult

Extraction.description: One extractor pass over a raw record; every observed value points at one.
Extraction.title: Extraction

FactAudit.description: The latest website audit of the business's crawled site.
FactAudit.title: FactAudit

FeatureState.description:
known: evaluated from evidence; unknown: the facts cannot show it (never a zero);
not_applicable: does not apply to this business (never a penalty).
FeatureState.title: FeatureState

FreshnessCriterion.description: A source listed the business within this many days.
FreshnessCriterion.title: FreshnessCriterion

GatePreview.description: How many businesses a gate lets through, stops or cannot decide, with examples of why.
GatePreview.title: GatePreview

GeoScope.description: One place to search. Sources declare how deep they can go (`Capability.GEOGRAPHY_*`).
GeoScope.title: GeoScope

IcpDefinition.description: One version of an ICP profile, stored verbatim in `icp_profile_versions.definition_json`.
IcpDefinition.title: IcpDefinition

IcpExclusions.description: Hard exclusions, checked before anything is weighed.
IcpExclusions.title: IcpExclusions

IcpProfile.description:
A named ideal-customer profile (phase 11): which version is active and whether it is
archived. Its definitions are `icp_profile_versions`.
IcpProfile.title: IcpProfile

IcpProfileVersion.description: Immutable, permanent definition of an ICP profile at one version (`IcpDefinition`).
IcpProfileVersion.title: IcpProfileVersion

IcpProfileView.description: A profile with every version, newest first, and what validation says about the newest.
IcpProfileView.title: IcpProfileView

IcpSaveRequest.description:
A new profile when `profile_id` is null (clone = a new profile from another's definition),
otherwise a new version of it; an identical definition reuses the latest version.
IcpSaveRequest.title: IcpSaveRequest

ImportPreview.description: What the file holds and what the mapping would make of it. Nothing is stored yet.
ImportPreview.title: ImportPreview

ImportPreviewRequest.description: Preview of a file the operator picked. The content travels once, inside this request.
ImportPreviewRequest.title: ImportPreviewRequest

ImportProblem.description: A row the import cannot use, named by its line so the operator can fix the file.
ImportProblem.title: ImportProblem

InferenceOutput.description:
One answer of the model, raw, next to the structure it validated to (or why it did not).
Immutable, and never a fact by itself.
InferenceOutput.title: InferenceOutput

InferenceRun.description:
One local-model task (phase 10): task, runtime, model, digest, parameters, prompt and schema
versions, the exact input it saw and its hash, what it cost and how it ended. Rebuilt by
migration 0009; `cache_key` makes an identical request reuse a valid result.
InferenceRun.title: InferenceRun

InferredImpact.description: The probable commercial impact of a problem: an inference, labelled as one.
InferredImpact.title: InferredImpact

JobEvent.description: Progress, warnings and errors of a job; errors carry a code and retry classification.
JobEvent.title: JobEvent

JobEventQuery.description: The persisted log. A pipeline's events include those of its engine jobs.
JobEventQuery.title: JobEventQuery

LatinoAssessment.description: One evaluation; a newer one supersedes it. Separate from the evidence it cites.
LatinoAssessment.title: LatinoAssessment

LatinoAssessmentEvidence.description: Evidence an assessment cites, with the factors the rules gave it at that moment.
LatinoAssessmentEvidence.title: LatinoAssessmentEvidence

LatinoAssessmentView.description: One assessment with its warnings and what it cannot conclude (from `details_json`).
LatinoAssessmentView.title: LatinoAssessmentView

LatinoDetail.description:
The Latino evidence of a canonical business: what it shows (a person's review, else the
rules), the automatic calculation, every piece of evidence of its records ordered by track,
strength and freshness, and the history of assessments and review decisions.
LatinoDetail.title: LatinoDetail

LatinoEvidence.description: One piece of evidence with the factors the rules give it now.
LatinoEvidence.title: LatinoEvidence

LatinoRequirement.description:
What a campaign asks of Latino evidence: nothing, market affinity or better, or a verified
Latino-owned business. It filters; it never measures quality or buying capacity.
LatinoRequirement.title: LatinoRequirement

LatinoReviewFilter.description: Businesses by the state of a person's review of their Latino evidence (phase 07).
LatinoReviewFilter.title: LatinoReviewFilter

LatinoReviewRequest.description:
A person's assessment with its mandatory reason. A null status withdraws the review, so the
business shows the automatic calculation again.
LatinoReviewRequest.title: LatinoReviewRequest

LatinoStartRequest.description: Evaluates one project, or every live project when `project_id` is null (one job each).
LatinoStartRequest.title: LatinoStartRequest

LatinoStats.description: Counts of one evaluation run, read back from its last checkpoint.
LatinoStats.title: LatinoStats

LatinoTrack.description: What a piece of evidence can speak to. Market affinity never speaks to ownership.
LatinoTrack.title: LatinoTrack

LeadAction.description: confirm or dismiss a score after reviewing it, reset that review, or record an outcome.
LeadAction.title: LeadAction

LeadIndexRow.description:
One business in one score run, projected from its stored score for the Lead Explorer
(phase 12). Written with the score, rebuilt from `business_scores` when missing; `rank` is the
business's place in the run once it finished. A projection: the scorecard stays the record.
LeadIndexRow.title: LeadIndexRow

LeadOutcome.description:
Immutable, permanent record of what happened when a lead was worked (phase 11): the feedback
loop that calibration reads. A `lost` outcome says why.
LeadOutcome.title: LeadOutcome

LeadResearch.description:
The research status of a canonical business and whom it is assigned to (phase 12). Current
state only: every change is also a `review_decisions` row, which is its history.
LeadResearch.title: LeadResearch

LeadScoreQuery.description: The ranked leads of a run; `score_run_id` null reads the newest finished run.
LeadScoreQuery.title: LeadScoreQuery

LeadScorecard.description: The explanation of one lead in one run, stored with its score (`business_scores`).
LeadScorecard.title: LeadScorecard

LeadTier.description:
Where a business lands in one score run (phase 11). `priority`, `review` and `low` are scored
by the thresholds of the scoring model; `insufficient_data`: a gate could not be decided or too
much of the formula is unknown; `excluded`: a gate failed, and there is no total.
LeadTier.title: LeadTier

LlmFitReport.description:
What the external LLM Fit tool says, when installed and asked. An outside opinion: nothing
here is applied, installed or changed.
LlmFitReport.title: LlmFitReport

MailDomainCheck.description: The cached answer of one mail-domain lookup; asked again once it expires.
MailDomainCheck.title: MailDomainCheck

MailDomainResult.description: What a mail-domain lookup answered. `timeout` and `error` say nothing about the domain.
MailDomainResult.title: MailDomainResult

MatchCandidate.description:
A pair of records the resolution rules looked at: the evidence, the outcome and its status.

`features_json` holds the compared values and blocking keys, `reasons_json` every weight and
rule that produced the score. The pair never changes; evidence is refreshed by a new run, and
`status` follows the person who reviewed it (`is_manual`) or else the engine.
MatchCandidate.title: MatchCandidate

MatchDetail.description:
One pair side by side: both records with their evidence, the comparison field by field, the
reasons behind the score, and every decision and merge that touched it.
MatchDetail.title: MatchDetail

MatchListQuery.description: The review queue: pairs by score, filtered by status, risk, minimum score and source.
MatchListQuery.title: MatchListQuery

MatchOutcome.description: What the resolution rules recommend for a pair of records (phase 06).
MatchOutcome.title: MatchOutcome

MatchStatus.description: Where a pair stands: waiting for a person, put aside, merged, or kept separate.
MatchStatus.title: MatchStatus

MaturityCriterion.description:
Digital maturity from the website subscores: low below 50, medium below 80, high otherwise;
a business without a website is low.
MaturityCriterion.title: MaturityCriterion

MessageDraft.description: A commercial message to adapt by hand. It is never sent.
MessageDraft.title: MessageDraft

MissingData.description: An unknown feature and the share of the final formula it could have moved.
MissingData.title: MissingData

NotApplicableRule.description: A feature that does not apply to businesses in these categories (booking for roofers...).
NotApplicableRule.title: NotApplicableRule

Offer.description: Something the seller can actually deliver, and the problems it solves.
Offer.title: Offer

OpportunityInput.description: What OPPORTUNITY_SCORE may weigh. Latino evidence is not one of them, by design.
OpportunityInput.title: OpportunityInput

PipelineStage.description: The stages of a campaign pipeline, in order. Each runs the engine job of its phase.
PipelineStage.title: PipelineStage

PipelineStartRequest.description:
Runs every stage over one project; a campaign adds discovery and acquisition. A repeated key
(a double click, a retry after a timeout) returns the pipeline it already started.
PipelineStartRequest.title: PipelineStartRequest

ProblemType.description: Observable problems the opportunity engine detects from stored facts.
ProblemType.title: ProblemType

Project.description: A local workspace. Synthetic projects hold test data only.
Project.title: Project

Provenance.description: Where one observed value came from: extraction, raw record, run and connector.
Provenance.title: Provenance

RawRecord.description: Immutable payload exactly as acquired. Either `source_url` or `external_id` identifies it.
RawRecord.title: RawRecord

RefreshScope.description:
What a refresh asks the engines for: the website pages (a crawl), the published contacts, or
the Latino evidence. Each one starts its job; nothing is sent to the business.
RefreshScope.title: RefreshScope

ReputationCriterion.description:
Rating and reviews with their source. No connected source provides them yet: this criterion
is always unknown, never a failure.
ReputationCriterion.title: ReputationCriterion

ResearchActionRequest.description:
One change to a lead's research. Everything that removes or overrides something needs a
reason; a status, a correction and a refresh are audited.
ResearchActionRequest.title: ResearchActionRequest

ResearchCheck.description: Immutable, permanent: a person ticked or unticked one manual checklist item.
ResearchCheck.title: ResearchCheck

ResearchChecklist.description: What an analyst verifies before a lead is sales-ready, for a vertical or a campaign.
ResearchChecklist.title: ResearchChecklist

ResearchStatus.description:
Where an analyst left a lead (phase 12), always with a reason. `sales_ready` is only allowed
when every criterion of `SalesReadyCriterion` holds; the others are a person's call.
ResearchStatus.title: ResearchStatus

ResearchTask.description: Work left on a lead. Closed with a reason when dismissed; reopened, never deleted.
ResearchTask.title: ResearchTask

ResolutionStartRequest.description: Resolves one project, or every live project when `project_id` is null (one job each).
ResolutionStartRequest.title: ResolutionStartRequest

ResolutionStats.description: Counts of one resolution run, read back from its last checkpoint.
ResolutionStats.title: ResolutionStats

ResourceUsage.description: This machine now, as the orchestrator sees it. Null means the OS did not say.
ResourceUsage.title: ResourceUsage

ReviewDecision.description: A human decision with its mandatory reason. Never edited; a new decision supersedes it.
ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision

RunEvent.description: One line of a run's log: progress, a limit reached, or a structured error.
RunEvent.title: RunEvent

SalesBriefOutput.description:
A model's wording of a brief: sentences per section, each citing the brief claims it
restates. It adds no fact, number, person or accusation.
SalesBriefOutput.title: SalesBriefOutput

SalesReadyCriterion.description: Every one must hold before a lead can be marked sales-ready (docs/lead-explorer.md).
SalesReadyCriterion.title: SalesReadyCriterion

SavedView.description: A named Lead Explorer view (phase 12); its definitions are `saved_view_versions`.
SavedView.title: SavedView

SavedViewSaveRequest.description: Creates a view, or a new version of one; an unchanged definition keeps the newest version.
SavedViewSaveRequest.title: SavedViewSaveRequest

SavedViewVersion.description:
Immutable, permanent definition of a view at one version. `schema_version` says which shape
`definition_json` has; older shapes are upgraded when read, never rewritten.
SavedViewVersion.title: SavedViewVersion

ScoreBin.description: Scored businesses whose total is in [low, low + 10) (the last bin includes 100).
ScoreBin.title: ScoreBin

ScoreComparison.description: Two runs side by side: who entered or left the top K and how ranks moved.
ScoreComparison.title: ScoreComparison

ScoreComponent.description: The independent components of a scorecard, 0 to 100 each (a null value is unknown).
ScoreComponent.title: ScoreComponent

ScoreComponentView.description:
`weight` and `contribution`: in the formula that uses this component (0 and null for
DATA_CONFIDENCE and FINAL_LEAD_SCORE); `coverage`: share of its own weight that was known.
ScoreComponentView.title: ScoreComponentView

ScoreEvidence.description: What a point rests on: the stored row it came from, and where to see it.
ScoreEvidence.title: ScoreEvidence

ScoreFeature.description: One evaluated feature. `points`: what it adds to its component; `impact`: to the total.
ScoreFeature.title: ScoreFeature

ScoreRisk.description: A contradiction, a caveat or a reason to double-check before acting.
ScoreRisk.title: ScoreRisk

ScoreRun.description:
One ICP version and one scoring version applied to a project's businesses, or to the facts
another run stored (`facts_from_run_id`). Only `finished_at` is written after the insert.
ScoreRun.title: ScoreRun

ScorecardQuery.description: `score_run_id` null reads the newest finished run that scored the business.
ScorecardQuery.title: ScorecardQuery

ScoringCatalog.description: Profiles and models to build with, the features a model can weigh and blank templates.
ScoringCatalog.title: ScoringCatalog

ScoringChangeRequest.description: Activates a version (`version_id`), archives or restores a profile or a model.
ScoringChangeRequest.title: ScoringChangeRequest

ScoringDefinition.description:
One version of a scoring model, stored verbatim in `scoring_model_versions.definition_json`.
Weights are relative within each formula; a weight of 0 leaves a feature or input out.
ScoringDefinition.title: ScoringDefinition

ScoringModel.description: A named scoring formula (phase 11): which version is active and whether it is archived.
ScoringModel.title: ScoringModel

ScoringModelVersion.description:
Immutable, permanent definition of a scoring model at one version (`ScoringDefinition`).
`is_heuristic`: its weights are a declared judgement, not fitted to outcomes.
ScoringModelVersion.title: ScoringModelVersion

ScoringSimulationRequest.description:
Scores drafts in memory, over a project's facts read now or a run's stored facts. Writes
nothing.
ScoringSimulationRequest.title: ScoringSimulationRequest

SizeCriterion.description: Size by its only observable proxy: distinct locations. Employees and revenue are not seen.
SizeCriterion.title: SizeCriterion

SizeProxy.description: Observable stand-ins for company size. No source is asked to guess one it cannot see.
SizeProxy.title: SizeProxy

SourceConnectorConfig.description: Effective configuration and limits of a connector, globally or for one project.
SourceConnectorConfig.title: SourceConnectorConfig

SourceEstimate.description: Always an estimate, never a promise. `value` is null when the source cannot count.
SourceEstimate.title: SourceEstimate

SourceHealth.description: Whether this source could run right now, and why not when it could not.
SourceHealth.title: SourceHealth

SourceInfo.description: One registered source: what it is, what it may do and whether it could run right now.
SourceInfo.title: SourceInfo

SourceMetadata.description: Everything the app can say about a source without running it.
SourceMetadata.title: SourceMetadata

SourceSelection.description: A connector this campaign uses. `config_json` holds per-campaign settings, never secrets.
SourceSelection.title: SourceSelection

SuppressionChangeRequest.description:
Adds an entry (`suppression_id` null, with `kind` and `value`) or lifts one
(`suppression_id`); both need a reason.
SuppressionChangeRequest.title: SuppressionChangeRequest

SuppressionExport.description: The list as CSV; cells that a spreadsheet would run as a formula are neutralised.
SuppressionExport.title: SuppressionExport

SuppressionImportRequest.description: A CSV of `kind,value,reason` rows the operator picked; the content travels once.
SuppressionImportRequest.title: SuppressionImportRequest

SuppressionKind.description:
What a do-not-contact entry covers (phase 09): one address, one number, every address and
form of a domain, or every contact of a business.
SuppressionKind.title: SuppressionKind

SyntheticSeedResult.description: Development-only seed. `created` is false when the synthetic workspace already existed.
SyntheticSeedResult.title: SyntheticSeedResult

UiErrorReport.description: Technical UI error forwarded to the desktop log (the UI never writes logs itself).
UiErrorReport.title: UiErrorReport

ViewDefinition.description:
Schema version 2 of a saved view. Version 1 (flat `and` conditions, one sort key, the visible
columns only) is upgraded when read, never rewritten.
ViewDefinition.title: ViewDefinition

WebsiteAudit.description:
One audit of a crawled site: rules of one version over a snapshot of what one crawl acquired.
History: a newer crawl or ruleset makes a new audit that points at the previous one.
WebsiteAudit.title: WebsiteAudit

WebsiteAuditListQuery.description:
The latest audit of every site of a project (or of every project), or every audit of one
site when `site` is given, newest first.
WebsiteAuditListQuery.title: WebsiteAuditListQuery

WebsiteAuditStatus.description:
complete: every page the crawl acquired was analyzed; partial: some were not (the coverage
says which and why); empty: no page could be analyzed.
WebsiteAuditStatus.title: WebsiteAuditStatus

WebsiteAuditSummary.description: What an audit shows besides its findings; stored with it, so history reads the same.
WebsiteAuditSummary.title: WebsiteAuditSummary

WebsiteCategory.description: What a website rule speaks to; each category has its own subscore.
WebsiteCategory.title: WebsiteCategory

WebsiteDiff.description: What changed since the previous audit of the same site.
WebsiteDiff.title: WebsiteDiff

WebsiteEvidence.description: Where something was observed: the crawled URL, the field read and the fragment.
WebsiteEvidence.title: WebsiteEvidence

WebsiteFindingChange.description: A rule whose result changed; null when the rule did not exist on that side.
WebsiteFindingChange.title: WebsiteFindingChange

WebsitePageView.description:
A page the crawl acquired or tried, whether it could be analyzed (and why not), with the
crawler's lab measurements: one sample, no device or network emulation, never field data.
WebsitePageView.title: WebsitePageView

WebsiteStartRequest.description:
Audits the crawled sites of one project, or of every live project when `project_id` is null
(one job each). `sites` narrows one project's audit to some of its sites, to retry them.
WebsiteStartRequest.title: WebsiteStartRequest

WebsiteStats.description: Counts of one audit run, read back from its last checkpoint.
WebsiteStats.title: WebsiteStats

WebsiteSubscore.description: `score` is null when no rule of the category could be evaluated.
WebsiteSubscore.title: WebsiteSubscore
